title: xi command definition
description: A new command menu record for ROM/118/114.DAT (comm: job abilities, pet commands, weapon skills…) and its names/help: a retail command to clone plus the fields and texts that differ. Read by `xi dats prepare --type command` / the `command` action; see docs/menu/records.md.

name.description: Slug: the action id (command.<name>), the resource file name and the server row name.

like.description: The retail command id whose record is cloned (type, icon, targets, TP come from it).

id.description: The command id to take. auto = the highest free id above the retail band (2816..4095); ids inside the retail band need --force.

text.description: Names hold 39 cp932 bytes and help 215 (a Japanese character takes 2); maxLength assumes one byte per character, the loader checks bytes.

fields.description: Record fields to change on the clone (anything not named keeps the donor's value).

type.description: 1 ability, 2 pet ability, 3 weapon skill, 4 trait … (xi.common.xi_menu_records.COMM_TYPE_NAMES).

text.help_en: Goads all enemies in range into attacking you.
